gate.noPermissionBody: Your staff role ({role}) does not include this page. Ask a Super Admin if you need it.
gate.goToAllowed: Go to a page you can use

roleChoice.beyondYou: Grants permissions you do not hold yourself

reasonDialog.reasonTooShort: Write at least {count} characters. The reason is the only record of why.
reasonDialog.genericError: Nothing was changed. The server refused the request or could not record it in the audit log.

invite.title: Invite staff
invite.description: An address that already has a WarpTalk account gets access at once. Any other address gets an invitation that activates the first time someone signs in with it, verified, within 7 days.
invite.noteLabel: Note (optional, recorded in the audit log)
invite.emailNotSent: The email could not be sent. The access stands; tell them yourself.

changeRole.title: Change {name}'s role
changeRole.description: Takes effect on every service within 30 seconds. Their next sign-in shows the new role.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: The people who run WarpTalk, the role each one holds, and when they last used the portal.
staff.count: {count, plural, one {# staff member} other {# staff members}}
staff.emptyDescription: Clear the search or filters to see everyone.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Addresses with no WarpTalk account yet. Each activates on its first verified sign-in.

suspend.title: Suspend staff access
suspend.description: They keep their WarpTalk account but lose the admin portal on every service within 30 seconds. You can reactivate them later.

reactivate.title: Reactivate staff access
reactivate.description: Their role applies again on every service within 30 seconds.

remove.title: Remove staff access
remove.description: Their account stays; only the staff access goes. The audit log keeps everything they did.

revoke.title: Revoke invitation
revoke.description: The address will not get staff access when it signs in.

roleEditor.builtInDescription: Built-in roles cannot be changed. Duplicate this one to make a custom role you can edit.
roleEditor.ownRoleDescription: This is your own role, so you cannot edit it. Ask another administrator.
roleEditor.description: Choose what people with this role may see and do. You can grant only permissions you hold yourself.
roleEditor.superAdminNote: Super Admin holds every permission, including ones added in the future.
roleEditor.notGrantable: You do not hold this permission

holders.error: Could not load who holds this permission.
holders.roles: {count, plural, one {# role grants it} other {# roles grant it}}
holders.members: {count, plural, one {# person holds it} other {# people hold it}}

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: What each staff role may see and do. Built-in roles are read-only; duplicate one to start a custom role.
roles.emptyDescription: Clear the search or filters to see every role.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}
deleteDialog.description: Only a role nobody holds can be deleted. It disappears from the lists; the audit log keeps its history.
